title: KOTHA: RCT-anchored conditional borrowing workflow
description: Decision/reporting workflow for RCT-anchored, conditional borrowing of external aggregate evidence (HR, OR, RR). Uses established methods (fixed-alpha and normalised power priors, robust MAP) through a frozen engine (SHA-256 7b7d07f4bf6e29833ea869e82db5141258a8408682aa2f3ddd1e6059a8a2e7ef). It is not a novel Bayesian estimator and showed no net decision advantage over robust MAP with the same observable screen in the accompanying simulations. Research use only.
